0.0: Welcome, #b#ho##k. I still remember your first moment as a Resistance member.
0.1: With you in the Resistance, we've taken great strides toward freedom.\r\n
0.2: As thanks, I wanted to give you this. Not just anyone can get one, even in the Resistance.

no.0: But you... You deserve this. Please allow us to show our appreciation with this gift.

yes.0: Thank you, from one Resistance member to another. I look forward to seeing what else you get up to.\r\n
